question: ____ has been awarded the title of India's Fastest Growing Sustainable Brand for 2023-24.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gruner Renewable Energy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gruner Renewable Energy has been honored** as India's Fastest Growing Sustainable Brand for 2023-24.
 
• This** prestigious recognition was awarded during a landmark event in Dubai at the JW Marriott Marquis Hote**l, Business Bay, as part of the 24th Edition of the Asian Business and Social Forum
 
• The award was** honoured by the renowned Indian politician Shri Anurag Thakur, Member of the Lok Sabha.**
 
• The **company has recently secured contracts for 11 compressed biogas plants,** each valued at an average of ₹100 crores.
 
• With these plants,** the company will produce an average of 88,000 tons of compressed biogas (CBG) annually.**
